# Mikegabyte — Frontend Developer

> Personal portfolio of Mikegabyte, a frontend developer working with Vue, React,
> TypeScript and WordPress, focused on building web tools for marketing and content.
> The site is bilingual (Vietnamese default, English available under /en/).

## Pages

- [Home](https://mikegabyte.com/): Intro and overview of what Mikegabyte builds.
- [Projects](https://mikegabyte.com/projects): Featured work and side projects.
- [The Tour (About)](https://mikegabyte.com/about): Background, approach, and journey.
- [Blog](https://mikegabyte.com/blog): Build logs and technical write-ups.

## Projects

- SEO Audit AI (shipped): AI-scored on-page SEO reports streamed live to the UI. Stack: Vue 3, TypeScript, AI APIs, Node.js. https://github.com/mikegabyte/seo-audit-ai
- PMS SaaS (in progress): Turning a property-management system for homestays into a multi-tenant SaaS. Stack: React, Refine, Node.js, MongoDB.
- AI Push-up Counter (shipped): In-browser push-up counting via TensorFlow.js pose detection; offline-capable PWA. Stack: Vue 3, TypeScript, TensorFlow.js, PWA.
- WP Marketing Toolkit: WordPress tooling for marketing and content workflows.
